name: World Tennis
summary: The world governing body for tennis, wheelchair tennis and beach tennis, now presenting itself as World Tennis (formerly the International Tennis Federation, ITF). It writes the Rules of Tennis and runs the Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup and the ITF tours.

name: International Table Tennis Federation
summary: The world governing body for table tennis. It sets the Laws of Table Tennis in its Statutes and approves equipment such as balls, tables and racket coverings.

name: USA Pickleball
summary: The national governing body for pickleball in the United States. Its Official Rulebook is also used by many other countries, and it runs paddle and ball approval with its equipment programme.

founded.text: 1984, as the United States Amateur Pickleball Association
founded.editorNote: Timeline also records a new corporation, the USA Pickleball Association, in 2005 and the rebrand as USA Pickleball in 2020.

headquarters.editorNote: Not verified: usapickleball.org About page gives no headquarters; the Contact page returned 403 on 2026-10-24.

summary: An international federation for pickleball, founded as the International Federation of Pickleball (IFP).
